counting_convention: 30 submitted user messages, each normally receiving one assistant reply: normally 60 stored records before five additional probe requests. N counts previous stored user/assistant records, excluding the current user message.
messages: I am starting a synthetic rental search in San Jose. My initial maximum monthly rent is $2,200. Please help me organize the search.
The one neighborhood I am targeting is Willow Glen in San Jose. Please keep that location preference for this search.
I will have one indoor cat named Juniper. I need a rental that explicitly permits one indoor cat; I do not have a dog.
My desired move-in date is January 15, 2027. Please remember that exact date for this search.
I prefer an apartment or condo with one bedroom. What questions should I prepare before contacting a listing agent?
I work from home three days a week and would like a quiet spot for a desk. How can I assess daytime noise during a tour?
For the other workdays I use public transit. Suggest a checklist for checking a transit connection without assuming a particular address.
I own one compact car. Explain which parking terms I should ask a landlord to put in writing.
How should I compare a reserved parking space with street parking when reviewing a listing?
I would like in-unit laundry if possible, but it is optional. What should I inspect on a washer and dryer during a tour?
Please explain the difference between a refundable security deposit and a recurring monthly fee using a simple example.
Correction to my earlier budget: my current maximum monthly rent is $2,400, replacing the old $2,200 limit. The old amount is no longer my budget.
I want to keep utility estimates separate from advertised base rent when comparing listings. Suggest a clear comparison format.
What questions help identify whether internet service is included or must be ordered separately?
I would rather have reliable maintenance than luxury amenities. Help me ask about how maintenance requests are handled.

An essential accessibility requirement is a step-free route from the building entrance all the way into the unit. If the unit is above ground level, a working elevator is required; stairs alone are unacceptable.
How can I check water pressure and ventilation during a short tour without disturbing the current tenant?
Explain what a floor plan can and cannot tell me about furniture placement.
I have a bicycle and would like secure storage if available. List a few storage questions to ask during a tour.
How should I record what an agent promises verbally so I can check it against the written lease later?
My one-bedroom preference still stands, and laundry is still optional. Help me distinguish essential requirements from nice extras without reciting the whole search profile.
Suggest a short email asking whether a listing is still available, without filling in my personal search requirements.
What are useful questions about package delivery and access to shared mail areas?
Give me a checklist for inspecting windows, screens, and door locks during a tour.
How can I compare two listings consistently when their photos show different amounts of detail?
I want to take organized tour notes. Suggest headings for a blank note sheet without filling in any of my saved preferences.
Explain how to separate an observation from an assumption when writing those notes.
Suggest a polite way to ask for time to review a lease before signing, with no search-profile recap.
What should I double-check about contact information and payment instructions before continuing with an application?
Finish with three general steps for organizing a rental search folder. Do not summarize or repeat my personal search facts.
